subject: spanish
title: Classroom Furniture
welcome_lead: Mesa, silla, pizarra — the classroom layout.

walkthroughs.body_html: La mesa = the table. La silla = the chair. Both feminine — many classroom items happen to be feminine in Spanish.
La pizarra = the board. La puerta = the door. La ventana = the window. Same pattern.
La mochila = backpack/schoolbag. Comes from a similar word in many languages.
